headline: Tell your child about today.
sub: A minute is plenty. It becomes a letter.

headline: Every change is marked.
sub: We only fix small slips. Tap one to put it back.

headline: Your voice stays with each letter.
sub: The original recording is kept unchanged.

headline: A book that grows by month.
sub: Each letter goes into your child's month of age.

headline: Read together at bedtime.
sub: One letter at a time, oldest first.

headline: Your book stays on your phone.
sub: Private by default. Never sold, never used for ads.

headline: Quiet days are fine.
sub: Tap Not much today. That is enough.

headline: Pause, laugh, start again.
sub: Take your time. Say it however it comes.
